rationale_overall: One swap this quarter: SMR exits on a genuine thesis breach (its flagship SMR demo project, CFPP, was cancelled Nov 8 2023) rather than a valuation call, and ASTS enters as a second rockets_spacecraft name to capture the satellite-services sub-theme the profile ranks as the top near-term next wave, backed by a dated Q3 business update announcing its first five commercial satellites are in build with a Q1 2024 launch target. The dominant AI wave (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA) stays untouched and looks stronger than last quarter — Gemini's Dec 6 launch, Copilot's Nov/Dec GAs, and NVDA's record $14.5B data-center quarter are all fresh buildup/surge evidence. RKLB, ITA, BOTZ, IONQ, FRO, and WELL are kept: each has intact or improving dated evidence this quarter and none shows a fundamental breach. Watchlist stays at the 12-ticker cap.
